The body requires exactly one of `git` or `image`, and both are nested objects the closed request schema cannot express — `git` carries ten properties including `buildFilter`, which is itself an object (the same field `create-service` omits as opaque). Omitting them instead of excluding the route would ship an operation whose REQUIRED input no caller can supply, which is worse than its absence. The other 18 `/build-sources` operations are admitted; only creation is withheld.
